start: Sign in screen, 'Verify with WhatsApp' is on, the owner forgot the PIN

steps.action: Open the forgot-PIN card and type the mobile number
user_sees: 'First we check that this mobile number is yours. You send us one WhatsApp message. It is free.'
Box 'Your mobile number' with +91
Green button 'Verify with WhatsApp'
must_not: The number typed on Sign in not carried over

steps.action: Tap 'Verify with WhatsApp' and send the ready message from WhatsApp
user_sees: A waiting step with the message to send
Back in the panel: the number shown as checked
must_not: A code sent to any number other than MettleUp’s
The step stuck on waiting after the message went

steps.action: Type a new 6-digit PIN twice under 'Choose a new 6-digit PIN'
user_sees: Button 'Save new PIN'
must_not: The PIN shown in clear to someone standing by without asking

steps.action: Tap 'Save new PIN'
user_sees: 'Please wait…'
The gym opens, signed in
must_not: Signed in but the old PIN still works
The new PIN saved for a different number

start: Sign in screen while the older way (we send a code) is the one switched on

steps.action: Open the forgot-PIN card, type the number, tap 'Send code on WhatsApp'
user_sees: 'We send a 6-digit code to your mobile number on WhatsApp. Then you choose a new PIN.'
Then: 'If +91 98290 12345 has an account, a code is on its way on WhatsApp. It works for 10 minutes.'
must_not: Different words for a number with no account

steps.action: Type the code in 'Code from WhatsApp' and a new PIN twice, tap 'Set new PIN and sign in'
user_sees: The gym opens, signed in
must_not: The code accepted a second time
The PIN set when the code was wrong

start: Forgot-PIN card, wrong input at each step

steps.action: Type 5 digits as the number and tap 'Verify with WhatsApp'
user_sees: 'Type a 10-digit mobile number, like 98290 12345.'
must_not: A WhatsApp step started for a broken number

steps.action: After the number is checked, type 111111 twice and save
user_sees: 'That PIN is too easy to guess. Don’t use one digit six times, digits in order like 123456, or the end of your mobile number.'
must_not: The easy PIN saved
The number check asked for again because of a refused PIN

steps.action: Type two different PINs and save
user_sees: 'The two PINs are not the same. Type the same PIN in both boxes.'
must_not: Either PIN saved

steps.action: In the older way: type a wrong code
user_sees: 'That code is wrong. 4 tries left.' (the count goes down)
At the end: 'That code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new code.'
must_not: Endless tries
The PIN set

steps.action: In the older way: tap 'Send a new code' at once
user_sees: 'A code was sent a moment ago. Wait 60 seconds, then ask again.' (the seconds may differ)
must_not: A second WhatsApp sent within the wait

start: Forgot-PIN card, the number already checked

steps.action: Wait more than 15 minutes on the new PIN boxes, then tap 'Save new PIN'
user_sees: 'This check has run out. Tap "Verify with WhatsApp" to check your number again.'
The card is back at the mobile number step
must_not: The PIN saved on an old check
A dead end with no button

steps.action: Check the number again, save a new PIN, but the internet drops right after the PIN is saved
user_sees: An error about the internet; the PIN boxes stay
must_not: Nothing said about whether the new PIN was saved

steps.action: Tap 'Save new PIN' again once the internet is back
user_sees: Words that say the new PIN is already saved and to sign in with it
must_not: 'This check has run out…' while the new PIN is in fact already saved
The person sent to check the number a second time for nothing

steps.action: Sign in on Sign in with the number and the new PIN
user_sees: The gym opens
must_not: The old PIN still working

start: Forgot-PIN card, a stranger types the owner’s number

steps.action: Type a number that has no account, then one that has, and start the check for each
user_sees: The same words and the same steps for both
must_not: Any word that tells whether the number has an account before the number is proven

steps.action: Try to finish without sending the WhatsApp message from that very number
user_sees: The card keeps waiting, then says the check ran out
must_not: A new PIN set by someone who does not hold the phone

steps.action: Finish as the real owner
user_sees: Signed in
must_not: The PIN readable anywhere afterwards
Other devices told nothing while they stay signed in with no word to the owner

start: Sign in screen, 'Verify with WhatsApp' is on, a front desk person forgot the PIN

steps.action: Open the forgot-PIN card, type the own number, tap 'Verify with WhatsApp', send the message
user_sees: The number shown as checked
must_not: The owner needed for this step

steps.action: Type a new PIN twice, tap 'Save new PIN'
user_sees: The gym opens with front desk rights
must_not: Owner rights
Money totals shown

start: Sign in screen, the older send-a-code way is on, a front desk person forgot the PIN

steps.action: Type the own number, tap 'Send code on WhatsApp', type the code and a new PIN twice, tap 'Set new PIN and sign in'
user_sees: 'If +91 … has an account, a code is on its way on WhatsApp. It works for 10 minutes.'
Then the gym opens
must_not: A code that lets the person in as someone else

start: A person the owner removed last week tries the forgot-PIN card

steps.action: Check the number with WhatsApp, type a new PIN twice, save
user_sees: 'Sign in with your mobile number first. Then you can set a PIN.'
must_not: A PIN set for a removed person
The removed person signed in

steps.action: Try Sign in with the number and that PIN
user_sees: 'That PIN or code is wrong, or the code has expired. Ask the gym owner for a new code. If you are the owner, make one on a device where you are signed in.'
must_not: The gym opening

start: A front desk person whose PIN is locked after too many wrong tries

steps.action: Use the forgot-PIN card: check the number, save a new PIN
user_sees: Signed in at once
must_not: The lock still in place after a proven number
The wait of 15 minutes still asked for

steps.action: The owner opens Staff & sign-in
user_sees: The person’s row says 'PIN set', with no lock words
must_not: The row still saying 'PIN locked till …'

start: A front desk person resets the own PIN without telling the owner

steps.action: Reset the PIN with the WhatsApp check
user_sees: Signed in
must_not: The owner needed to approve

steps.action: The owner opens Staff & sign-in
user_sees: Only 'PIN set' on that row
must_not: The PIN, or any part of it, shown to the owner
